construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch for this isolated build

input.issues: 0..1000 objects with unique nonblank id (max 100 characters, no surrounding whitespace), text (max 10000 characters; empty allowed), severity (low|medium|high|critical)

shared_schema.validation: One validate function is shared by analyze and CLI; unknown fields rejected. CLI also rejects duplicate JSON keys and nonstandard constants.
shared_schema.output: status, schema_version, synthetic, priority-sorted issues preserving original fields with sentiment and priority objects, summary, method
shared_schema.sentiment: label positive|neutral|negative, integer raw_score, evidence containing token, token_index, base_weight, negated, multiplier, contribution
shared_schema.priority: score, severity_rank, negative_urgency, reason and one-based rank
shared_schema.error: One JSON object with status=error and error message; CLI exits 2

cross_stage_handoffs: Validated issue text is scored with fixed lexical rules; raw_score is handed to severity-aware ranking within the single integrated functionality.

behavior.scoring: Lowercase English word tokenization; curly apostrophes normalized; evidence sums exactly to raw_score. Unknown words contribute zero; sign determines label.
behavior.negation: Odd count of listed negators in previous three word tokens reverses weight. Punctuation resets context.
behavior.intensification: Immediately preceding very, extremely or really doubles a matched word weight.
behavior.priority: Severity rank low=1, medium=2, high=3, critical=4. Score = 100*severity_rank + min(99,max(0,-raw_score)). Severity always dominates sentiment.
behavior.determinism: Descending priority score, then ascending case-sensitive id; no randomness, time dependency or input mutation.
behavior.fixture: All example records are synthetic; positive language never lowers a critical issue below lower-severity issues.

test_outcomes.suite: 10 unittest cases covering normal, edge, invalid input, ordering, determinism and CLI behavior
